reasoning_content: `nx` is not on PATH in this shell — `just up` runs dev servers via `pnpm nx serve`. Let me reproduce with `pnpm nx`:

action.command:
cd /workspace/app
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/boards-repro.log
setsid nohup pnpm nx run urboards:serve:instance --port=37315 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=boards.workspace.localhost < /dev/null > /tmp/boards-repro.log 2>&1 &
echo "repro pid $!"; sleep 160; echo "=== log ==="; tail -10 /tmp/boards-repro.log; echo "=== still running? ==="; ps aux | grep -E "urboards:serve|vite" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2,$11,$12}' | head -3 || echo "EXITED"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
